summary: Focused test of NEW features in this session: (1) ProjectGallery embla carousel on /project/:slug, (2) HomeIntro splash on /, (3) white background + Poppins body/Archivo display fonts, (4) footer wordmark image, (5) Settings HomeIntroCard + GET/PUT /api/home-intro endpoints, (6) per-image Ratio/Crop selectors in ProjectForm and their persistence on ImageItem model. Backend: 21/21 pytest cases pass (17 regression + 4 new: 3 home-intro + 1 image ratio/crop). Frontend: all listed NEW items verified on desktop and mobile — home-intro overlay renders, dismisses on click and auto after ~2.4s; body bg is rgb(255,255,255); mono/nav computed font is 'Poppins,...'; .display computed font is 'Archivo,...'; footer-wordmark is an ; project-gallery renders with prev/next buttons, disabled-at-edges works, counter '01 / NN' updates on navigation; image order matches API images array; mobile swipe (pointer drag) advances counter 01→02; gallery-caption + gallery-counter data-testids present. Editor: home-intro-form + upload/save testids present; opening a project shows 6 image rows with image-ratio- select and image-crop- checkbox, and the checkbox is disabled when ratio='Original' (auto).

issues: The large '.display' hero title (e.g. 'SUBTRACTED VOLUME') overflows the 390px viewport by ~45px, producing a small horizontal page scroll. The overflow is caused by the fixed-size display title, NOT by the new ProjectGallery. Consider clamping the title with word-break/overflow-wrap or a smaller mobile font-size for very long titles.

action_items: Optional: fix mobile horizontal overflow on project detail hero title (add word-break/overflow-wrap: break-word or reduce mobile font-size on .display for long titles).
critical_code_review_comments: ProjectGallery: emblaApi listeners registered in useEffect without cleanup — should return () => emblaApi.off('select', onSelect) to avoid leaking on unmount when navigating between projects fast.
ProjectGallery: `if (!images.length) return null;` is fine but the component receives images from parent — worth guarding for undefined too (images?.length).
HomeIntro: shows on EVERY Home load (per spec) which may annoy return visitors; consider sessionStorage flag if UX complaints arise (not a bug, product decision).

backend/server.py: GET /api/home-intro passes the raw settings doc through serialize() which drops _id but still returns the internal 'id' field ('home_intro'). Not a bug but slightly leaky — could return {'bg_image': ...} only.
server.py CORS still uses '*' with allow_credentials=True (carry-over from iteration 1) — same recommendation stands.

seed_data_creation: None new. Home-intro test used ephemeral PUT then restored. Ratio/crop test created 'TEST_Ratio Project' then deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py at /app/backend/tests now has 21 tests including TestHomeIntro (3) and TestImageRatioCrop (1). New public endpoint: GET /api/home-intro; new admin: PUT /api/admin/home-intro (HomeIntroIn { bg_image: str }). ImageItem model gained ratio (str, default 'auto') and crop (bool, default False). data-testids used: project-gallery, gallery-prev-button, gallery-next-button, gallery-counter, gallery-caption, gallery-slide-<i>, home-intro, home-intro-bg, home-intro-form, home-intro-upload-button, save-home-intro-button, footer-wordmark, image-ratio-<i>, image-crop-<i>. Counter format is `pad(selected) / pad(images.length-1)` where pad(n)=String(n+1).padStart(2,'0'), so shows '01 / 06' for 6 images.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking issues. Mobile title overflow pre-existing to gallery change; noted as design polish.
